A manual operation requires your attention for every order. A sovereign store processes orders identically whether you are watching or not, whether it is midnight or noon, whether it receives one order or fifty simultaneously. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain continuously. The webhook fires the moment a transaction receives on-chain confirmations. Your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-every-detail-5|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Worker receives the webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your Supabase database, generates a presigned download URL from Cloudflare R2 with a configurable expiry time, and sends the delivery email via Resend. The buyer receives their product before they have navigated away from the payment confirmation page.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting language that allows you to automate tasks across Google Workspace products, which can be a game-changer for digital commerce. In areas where traditional payment gateways are inadequate, leveraging Google Apps Script with crypto payment systems like NOWPayments enables creators to manage their sales efficiently. This infrastructure ensures that orders are processed swiftly, typically in under 30 seconds, which is crucial for maintaining customer satisfaction and trust.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture relies on a combination of Google Apps Script for backend logic and NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments sends a webhook notification to Google Apps Script once the payment is confirmed on-chain. The script then retrieves the order details, updates the database, and sends an automated email with the download link, all in a matter of seconds. This seamless integration is key to ensuring a reliable and efficient digital product delivery system.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed specifically for digital creators in regions facing financial isolation, such as Nigeria and Venezuela. Many of these creators sell digital products but cannot access traditional payment platforms. By utilizing Google Apps Script and NOWPayments, they can establish an automated, self-sufficient retail environment. This empowers them to take control of their sales process without dependency on third-party services that may not be available or reliable in their regions.
Automate digital product delivery without traditional payment systems.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this system include Google Apps Script for executing the backend logic, NOWPayments for processing crypto payments, and a data storage solution such as Supabase or Google Sheets for managing order details. The combination of these technologies enables a robust framework where each element plays a critical role in achieving automated delivery. Additionally, the use of Cloudflare Workers allows for scaling, as they can handle up to 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier, ensuring that even high volumes of transactions are processed smoothly.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this solution, start by setting up your Google Apps Script project. Next, integrate NOWPayments for payment processing and configure your webhook to trigger order fulfillment. Store your order data in Supabase or Google Sheets. Finally, set up your email delivery system with Resend or Gmail to send automated download links upon payment confirmation. For a complete ready-to-use solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) which is pre-configured and can be deployed within 48 hours.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery with crypto payments works by using a webhook system. Once a payment is confirmed through a processor like NOWPayments, a webhook sends this information to Google Apps Script, which then triggers the order fulfillment process. The script accesses order details, stores them, and sends a download link to the customer almost instantly.
Google Apps Script enables seamless order processing in under 30 seconds.

Your Deployment Checklist

Set the webhook secret key before you test anything — this is the most commonly skipped step and it causes silent failures where webhooks arrive but are rejected before any processing occurs. Configure the same secret key string in your NOWPayments IPN settings and in your backend environment variables or Apps Script properties. Deploy your backend and confirm the endpoint returns HTTP 200 to a test POST request. Upload a test product file and configure it in your backend product list. Send a real mainnet transaction to your configured wallet address and watch your backend logs in real time. Confirm the webhook arrives, the signature validates, the transaction confirms on-chain, the order logs, and the delivery email sends with a working link.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I automate digital product delivery?

You can automate digital product delivery by integrating Google Apps Script with a payment processor like NOWPayments. When a payment is confirmed, a webhook triggers your script to send a download link to the customer, ensuring fast fulfillment.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a way for one application to send real-time data to another when a specific event occurs. In this case, when a payment is confirmed, NOWPayments sends a webhook to your Google Apps Script, which processes the order and sends the product link.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, by using Google Apps Script in conjunction with NOWPayments, you can automate the process of sending download links immediately after a payment is confirmed. This ensures your customers receive their products quickly.
What technologies are involved in this setup?

The setup involves Google Apps Script for backend processing, NOWPayments for handling crypto payments, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order data storage. This combination allows for efficient order management and automated fulfillment.
How quickly can I process orders with this system?
